items.title: OpenAI & Cisco team up on AI defense system 'Shirudo': Learn more from these execs
items.summary:
Cisco (CSCO) and OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) are partnering on Shirudo, a defense system against AI-powered cyberattacks.

Cisco president and chief product officer Jeetu Patel and OpenAI co-founder and president Greg Brockman sit down with Deirdre Bosa to discuss the details.

items.title: Nvidia Adds Nearly $1 Trillion in Value as Trump Hails Huang as a “National Treasure.” It’s Still Cheaper Than Walmart
items.summary: Key TakeawaysNVIDIA shares jumped 31% today after its board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, adding nearly $1 trillion of market value. The November selloff priced in a leadership crisis while analysts kept raising NVIDIA’s earnings estimates.

items.title: Jensen Huang is back: Does Washington have a seat in the boardroom?
items.summary: As Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang and investors add a trillion dollars to the stock, Deirdre Bosa dives into the White House's role in his return and asks General Catalyst's Madhu Namburi, who spent 25 years advising tech boards at J.P. Morgan, how boards, CEOs and dealmakers operate under the new rules.

items.title: Cisco, OpenAI Launch Project to Safeguard Agentic AI
items.summary: The project, called Shirudo, helps protect running Linux systems without a reboot while teams roll out a patch.

items.title: Jensen Huang's reinstatement changes how politics, business interact forever
items.summary:
The White House played a role in pressing Nvidia's (NVDA) board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, president, and chairman, all of which came just hours after President Trump called into a board meeting early Monday morning.

Deirdre Bosa raises questions about how involved the White House should be with Big Tech assets and the public markets.
